component.name: CtrlSpeak
component.summary: Desktop speech-to-text with embedded and remote transcription

description.p: CtrlSpeak records while the right Control key is held, transcribes with a bundled Whisper model or a configured HTTP API, and inserts the result in the active field.
Adds explicit, keyboard-accessible dismissal for the quick panel and control center, plus a truthful Show / hide quick-panel tray action.
Prevents competing PortAudio lifecycles during recording feedback, fixes the resulting Windows recording-start crash, and restores the approved Midnight Signal visual fidelity.
Introduces the Midnight Signal interface, truthful provider telemetry, accessible recording and processing overlays, and safer configurable audio cues.
